name: BTC-Neutral Residual Mean Reversion
description: Isolates idiosyncratic coin performance independent of Bitcoin using rolling regression. Trades residuals (returns net of BTC influence) for mean reversion. Best Sharpe ~2.3 in research.
author: Jarvis - External Research (Medium/briplotnik)

entry_rules.long: Residual Z-score below negative threshold (oversold relative to BTC)
entry_rules.short: Residual Z-score above positive threshold (overbought relative to BTC)

regression_window.description: Rolling regression window for beta calculation

btc_neutral_residual_mr.notes: Particularly strong post-2021. Isolates alpha from BTC beta.

research_notes.key_insight: Stripping out BTC component reveals true idiosyncratic alpha. Requires longer holding periods.
research_notes.risk_profile: Lower frequency, higher conviction per trade
